data.body: AC amendment (gap-analysis: implicit_assumption): Specify DSO_REVIEW_CYCLE env var vs ledger-derived cycle_num precedence in next_action docstring. Rules to define and test: (a) if both present and disagree, ledger wins (consistent with Story DD: 'ledger is authoritative'); (b) if env says cycle=3 but ledger len=1, log warning and use ledger value; (c) 'reset to 1 on SHA change' — does next_action mutate the ledger or only return cycle_num=1? Decision: return only; caller writes fresh entry on next append (no mutation in dispatcher). Document in docstring and add unit test.
